title: A Bias in Disguise: Tiny Gradient Edits Stop a Small Language Model's Thinking Loops and Complement a Frontier Model's Weight Edit
abstract: arXiv:2611.33133v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Qwen3.5-0.8B rarely finishes reasoning in thinking mode: at a 4,096-token budget only 1 or 2 of 500 MATH-500 answers close their think block (two seeds), and accuracy is 15.4%. A recent demonstration had GPT-6 Astra edit 131,072 of the model's weights without gradients and reported MATH-500 rising from 7.9% to 48.1% at a 32,768-token budget. We provide the missing gradient baseline, then combine the two edits. Fine-tuning only the 140 to 139,750 weights with the largest gradient, on the model's own correct answers to MATH training problems, raises thinking-mode MATH-500 at 4k tokens to 39.0-45.5% after 2-9 minutes of training on one GPU; 50 training examples suffice, and 1,398 random positions give only 16.3%. The gradient concentrates the edit on the most nearly constant channel of each of the first three layers. Because the model has no bias terms, an edit confined to those channels acts as a constant vector added to the residual str

translated_title: 伪装的偏置：微小梯度编辑终止小语言模型的思考循环，并与前沿模型的权重编辑形成互补
translated_abstract: Qwen3.5-0.8B在思考模式下很少完成推理：在4,096个token的预算下，500个MATH-500答案中只有1或2个能关闭其思考块（两个随机种子），准确率仅为15.4%。最近的一项演示让GPT-6 Astra在无梯度的情况下编辑了该模型的131,072个权重，并报告在32,768个token预算下MATH-500从7.9%提升至48.1%。我们提供了缺失的梯度基线，然后将两种编辑方式结合起来。仅对梯度最大的140至139,750个权重进行微调（训练数据为模型自己对MATH训练题目的正确答案），在单GPU上训练2-9分钟后，可将4k token下思考模式的MATH-500提升至39.0-45.5%；50个训练样例即已足够，而随机选择1,398个位置只能达到16.3%。梯度将编辑集中在前三层中每层最接近恒定取值的通道上。由于该模型没有偏置项，局限于这些通道的编辑相当于一个加到残差流（原文此处截断）中的常数向量。
tldr: 该论文发现通过梯度选择极少量关键权重微调即可让小模型走出无休止的思考循环，其本质是为无偏置项的模型隐式添加偏置，并与前沿模型的无梯度权重编辑形成互补。
en_tdlr: Tiny gradient-guided weight edits stop a small language model's endless thinking loops by effectively acting as implicit bias terms, and they complement a frontier model's gradient-free weight edit.
